result.observed: Torch 2.11 and 2.8 same-host ladders and PT/ORT 2x2 matrices completed sequentially. Unpatched-to-export-patched PyTorch was exact in both versions. V18 ORT prefix drift localized to prefill_inputs_embeds image tokens, while ORT prefill failed layers 1..35 KV even on correct PyTorch prefix inputs.
